sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older man angled three quarters toward screen-right with eyes slightly upward/right, neatly slicked-back dark gray hair and conspicuous silver-gray side/front streaks, thick dark brows and a full straight dark-gray upper-lip moustache. Keep cheeks/jaw/chin bare with no beard. No hat or spectacles. Dark charcoal-blue suit with broad lapels, pale blue-white buttoned shirt and a deep red tie. Preserve serious closed mouth, crop, light and continuous pale gray painted photographic backing across the entire rectangle. Actual source alpha230..255 is recorded; visual native/nearest views show a complete painted rectangular background, not a cutout. Compact broad yellow mascot head with original hair/moustache and short neck fitted naturally into the shirt collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing chest-up older officer leaning his head slightly forward, looking upward beneath light gray brows with a deeply stern furrowed expression; dark slicked-back hair with gray temples. Smooth bare upper lip, jaw and chin without moustache or beard; no hat, glasses or added stubble. Gray military tunic closed high at the neck, deep red collar patches densely embroidered in gold leaves, small central gold throat button and gold braided shoulder ornaments with red trim. Preserve forward head angle, exact uniform colors and broad shoulders, original lighting and full pale gray painted rectangular backing. Source alpha249..255 does not visibly remove any background. Use compact mascot head and a very short broad neck within the same closed tunic opening.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven officer shown in a pronounced screen-right profile/three-quarter side view, looking right; keep the actual directional pose and closed mouth. No clearly visible moustache or beard; only the tiny light brown/gray side hair visible under the cap should remain, without inventing thick hair. Tall olive peaked cap angled with the head, very dark navy/black band and visor, gold cord and central gold wreath-like badge. Dark olive high-collared tunic with gold leaf-covered collar panels edged red, central gold throat button, gold shoulder braids on red bases and the source's partly cropped small colored ribbon/medal details at lower screen-right. Preserve framing, lighting and complete pale gray painted rectangular background; source alpha249..255 is recorded. Fit the collar around the mascot's short broad neck while keeping a fully mascot face.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up nearly frontal older officer, head/gaze slightly toward screen-left with alert blue eyes, a stern closed mouth and thick dark brows. Short neatly side-parted dark gray hair with lighter gray temples. Keep cheeks, upper lip and chin smooth with no moustache or beard; no hat or eyewear. Dark olive army service jacket with gold-edged buttoned shoulder straps, small gold collar badges, pale gray-khaki closed shirt and dark olive tie; preserve the partly cropped colored medal/ribbon cluster at lower screen-right. Keep crop, upper-left light, broad shoulders and full pale gray-green painted backing across the rectangle. Source alpha249..255 is recorded without calling it a cutout; compact mascot head and short broad neck adapted into the original buttoned collar.
